subject.title: feat(feeds): add publisher following control UI

question: Should signed publisher-feed following, its gateway RPCs, scheduler, and shared SQLite state be accepted as a permanent OpenClaw core surface rather than an external plugin or ClawHub integration?
rationale: The branch adds a new control-plane capability and persistent product model across core, gateway, CLI, and UI; repository policy routes optional integrations outward unless a missing core seam or explicit product decision justifies core ownership.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Move the publisher-feed transport, trust configuration, scheduler, and UI integration into a plugin or ClawHub package using existing extension seams.

options.title: Sponsor core ownership
options.body: Accept a core gateway and state contract, then require explicit upgrade proof and ownership review for the RPC, scheduler, and persisted model.

recommendation.title: Keep it external
recommendation.body: Move the publisher-feed transport, trust configuration, scheduler, and UI integration into a plugin or ClawHub package using existing extension seams.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the currently open stacked implementation and can supply the missing technical proof, while repository ownership history was unavailable in this review environment.
